baikonur.interpretation: Existing lease-mask geometry tested as geographic containment only; not Soviet-period lease status.

checksSummary.connectivity: All 12 candidate component counts and every component interior control exactly retained from the authorized donor; no candidate-side fragmentation.
checksSummary.holesIslands: All 12 candidate component and interior-ring counts equal authorized donors. Prior-source counts reported separately; donor replacement is not historical-accuracy certification.

numericPolicy.sharedBoundary: Exact original-double intersection, then local LAEA metre measurement. No snapped contacts added.
numericPolicy.neighbors: Modern authorized donors are spatial comparison counterparts only, not assertions of independent-state status in 1990/1991.
numericPolicy.polygonAreaOnly: Only polygon members contribute area; LineString.GetArea may implicitly close open lines and is never used as overlap area.
